name: Xander Edwards
strengths: Edwards hits the designed hole on one cut — no dance — and is already into the second level.
Edwards finds cutback daylight when the interior clogs and finishes with a clear second gear on the edge.
Edwards keeps his feet through arm tackles and shows natural hands on swing routes out of the backfield.
weaknesses: Edwards still has room to add SEC contact strength at 6-1 / 205 before he can lean on every early-down snap.
comparison: Edwards comps to Tony Pollard — 6-0 / 210 mold; one-cut vision, cutback feel, and enough juice to finish outside.
projection: Edwards projects as early package/special-teams contributor, then Year-2 rotation with every-down starter upside as a feature back.
schemeFit: Edwards fits a zone/gap RB room that wants vision, one-cut decisiveness, and edge finish.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-04 from Hudl embeds. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default. Beat Desk session.
recruitingStory: Xander Edwards is a 4-star RB · listed 6-1 / 205 · The Bolles School (Jacksonville, FL) · Natl #108 · Pos #6 · State #15 — open-board Florida target with UF offer and multiple unofficials.
angle: Lead with one-cut / cutback tape and Florida process (nonstop contact, visit stack). Pollard mold for size/traits.
